source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 5 (a)-(c): velocity, acceleration and rest times for s(t) = 5t^3 - 12t^2 + 8t (book p.257). Answer key (PDF 311) prints it as number 11.

blocks.prompt: 5 (a) The position of a particle moving along a line is given by \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 12t^2 + 8t\), where \(s(t)\) is the position in meters and \(t\) is the time in seconds. Determine the velocity of the particle at \(t = 4\) seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Velocity position ka derivative hai.
Humein \(v(4)\) find karni hai.
Yaad rakhein: position se velocity ek derivative, aur velocity se acceleration doosra derivative; yeh silsila poore sawal mein chalega.
Plan: \(s(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(t = 4\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 12t^2 + 8t\) (meters aur seconds).
Humein find karna hai: \(v(4)\).
Tareeqa: \(v(t) = s'(t)\), jaise Example 13 mein kiya tha.

\(t = 4\) rakhein
\[v(4) = 15(16) - 24(4) + 8\]
\[= 240 - 96 + 8 = 152\]
Kyun: Pehle \(4^2 = 16\), phir guna. Units: meters fi second, kyunke position meters mein aur waqt seconds mein hai.
Dhyan dein: \(15 \times 4^2\) ko \((15 \times 4)^2\) samajhna ghalat hai; power sirf 4 par hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\frac{s(4.001) - s(3.999)}{0.002} \approx 152.0\]
Kyun: \(t = 4\) ke ird gird chhote waqfe ki average velocity bhi 152 hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (b) The position of a particle moving along a line is given by \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 12t^2 + 8t\), where \(s(t)\) is the position in meters and \(t\) is the time in seconds. Find the acceleration at \(t = 4\) seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Acceleration velocity ka rate of change hai.
Humein \(a(4)\) find karni hai.
Plan: \(v(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(t = 4\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(v(t) = 15t^2 - 24t + 8\) (part (a) se).
Humein find karna hai: \(a(4)\).
Tareeqa: \(a(t) = v'(t)\). Jaise velocity batati hai position kitni tezi se badal rahi hai, waise hi acceleration batati hai velocity kitni tezi se badal rahi hai.

Velocity ko differentiate karein
\[a(t) = 30t - 24\]
Kyun: \(15t^2 \to 30t\), \(24t \to 24\), aur 8 ka derivative zero.

\(t = 4\) rakhein
\[a(4) = 120 - 24 = 96\]
Kyun: Unit \(\text{m/s}^2\) hai: har second mein velocity 96 m/s ke hisaab se barh rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (c) The position of a particle moving along a line is given by \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 12t^2 + 8t\), where \(s(t)\) is the position in meters and \(t\) is the time in seconds. When is the particle at rest?
blocks.explanation:
"At rest" (ruka hua) ka matlab hai velocity zero.
Humein \(v(t) = 0\) hal karna hai.
Plan: quadratic \(15t^2 - 24t + 8 = 0\) ko quadratic formula se hal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(v(t) = 15t^2 - 24t + 8\).
Humein find karna hai: woh waqt jab particle ruka hua ho.
Tareeqa: Ruka hua \(\Leftrightarrow v(t) = 0\). Yeh quadratic aasaani se factorise nahi hoti, is liye formula \(t = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\) lagayenge.

Discriminant
\[b^2 - 4ac = 576 - 480 = 96\]
Kyun: \(a = 15\), \(b = -24\), \(c = 8\). \((-24)^2 = 576\) aur \(4 \times 15 \times 8 = 480\). Discriminant positive hai, to do alag real jawab milenge.

Quadratic formula
\[t = \dfrac{24 \pm \sqrt{96}}{30} = \dfrac{12 \pm 2\sqrt{6}}{15}\]
Kyun: \(-b = 24\) aur \(2a = 30\). \(\sqrt{96} = \sqrt{16 \times 6} = 4\sqrt{6}\), phir upar neeche 2 se divide.
Dhyan dein: \(-b\) mein sign badalta hai: \(b = -24\) hai to \(-b = +24\).

Decimal values
\[t = \dfrac{12 - 4.899}{15} \approx 0.47\ \text{s}\]
\[t = \dfrac{12 + 4.899}{15} \approx 1.13\ \text{s}\]
Kyun: \(2\sqrt{6} \approx 4.899\). Dono waqt positive hain, is liye dono qabool hain. Particle pehle aage jata hai, 0.47 s par ruk kar wapas mudta hai, phir 1.13 s par dobara ruk kar phir aage barhta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[v(0.4734) \approx 3.36 - 11.36 + 8 \approx 0\]
\[v(1.1266) \approx 19.04 - 27.04 + 8 \approx 0\]
Kyun: Dono waqt par velocity taqreeban zero hai, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Particle \(t = \frac{12 \pm 2\sqrt{6}}{15}\) par ruka hai, yani \(t \approx 0.47\ \text{s}\) aur \(t \approx 1.13\ \text{s}\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 11 par chhapa hai: (a) 152 m/s, (b) 96 m/s\(^2\), (c) \(t = 0.47\) sec aur \(t = 1.13\) sec, sab sahi.
